remainingQualification: Obtain explicit release-owner sequencing and qualify the exact eventual source; all four test shards and build must actually pass. Skipped jobs do not count.

Browser UI and interaction checks for Solo, Versus and Team main/pause rows: narrow and landscape layouts, standard/large text, visible focus, title truncation, loading/blocked/paused/playing labels, and Resume initially selected.
Actual keyboard B/N and opted-out shortcuts; custom gameplay conflicts, text fields, modifiers, repeat/composition, higher-priority handlers, background state, and nested practice ownership.
Actual touch and controller navigation/Confirm, including blocked playback retry without duplicate Play or accidental Pause; report physical devices separately from simulated tests.

Listen to pause/resume/next and transitions with effects and warnings audible, including next-while-paused and returning from overlays. Existing recordings gain no musical approval from these source tests.
Frozen artifact inspection, cold offline checks, public release markers and direct deployed playback acceptance remain required.
futureFingerprintChanges: If later work changes a declared input, preserve historical ledger revisions, regenerate compatible source-stage records using the established hosted procedure, obtain exact-source scoped review, then append reviewed successor records only when justified. Re-run production-history, reproducibility and readiness checks; do not invent review evidence or inherit changed-input approval.
